ValidationRule.description: The passport Expiry Date must be a future date for periodic Review Case if Passport photo required is checked.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Periodic Review"), ISCHANGED(cc_Passport_Expiry_Date__c), cc_Passport_Expiry_Date__c < TODAY(), pr_PassportPhotoRequired__c= true )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill in the Passport Expiry date field and it should be greater than today's date.
